text: Chalk is how you draw a pattern together. Each stick draws **Ritual Marks** on the ground, and the marks are what join a machine to the shape around it.
The same chalk also seals lasting links between Resonance Totems.

pages.title: Drawing marks
text: Right-click the top of a solid block to draw a mark on it. Each mark spends **one use**, and a stick holds **ten**.
Right-click a mark with chalk to rub it out. Erasing costs nothing, so fix mistakes freely.
A broken mark drops nothing: the chalk already paid for it. In creative mode chalk is never used up.

pages.title: Linking totems
text: Right-click one Resonance Totem with chalk, then a second within **16 blocks**, to seal a Lattice link between them (see [Lattice Conductor](lattice_conductor)). A link that takes spends one use.
Clicking the same totem twice cancels the link you started. Two totems already linked stay linked and cost nothing more.

pages.text: One craft makes **four** sticks of ten uses each.
